observation_id.description: Stable unique identity for this observation

canonicalHash.description: Molecule payload hash at time of observation

observation_type.description: Classification of observation — observations do not change constitutional reality. pipeline_stage_completed is a Molecule Event: post-identity runtime execution telemetry, distinct from epistemic signals.

conflict_flag.description: True if this observation contradicts an existing observation — conflict is recorded not resolved here

conflict_ref_id.description: observation_id of the conflicting observation if conflict_flag is true

actor_id.description: Who or what generated this observation

actor_domain_id.description: Which trust domain the actor belongs to

actor_trust_score.description: Snapshot of actor domain trust score at time of observation — frozen, never updated retroactively

lineage_type.description: For citation and reuse events — nature of the relationship to the citing molecule

citing_molecule_id.description: For citation and reuse events — the molecule doing the citing

model_signal_type.description: For model_signal_received — e.g. novelty_score, clarity_score, similarity_score

model_id.description: For model_signal_received — which model produced this signal

outcome_value.description: For outcome_observed — estimated value of the outcome

gap_type.description: For evidence_gap_observed — what kind of evidence is missing

gap_period_start.description: For evidence_gap_observed — start of the gap period

gap_period_end.description: For evidence_gap_observed — end of the gap period

recovery_attempts.description: For evidence_gap_observed — how many times recovery was attempted

propagation_depth.description: For propagation inheritance events — depth from challenged ancestor

propagation_source_event_id.description: For propagation inheritance events — the challenge event at the root

journal_sequence.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number — gaps indicate tampering

observation_hash.description: Hash of this observation content chained with prior entry hash — integrity chain

prior_entry_hash.description: Hash of the immediately preceding journal entry — enables chain verification

constitution_version.description: Constitution version operative at time of observation — v1.0

runtime_id.description: For pipeline_stage_completed — which Origin Runtime execution produced this event, post-identity

stage_name.description: For pipeline_stage_completed — which of the 9 lifecycle stages this event records (canonicalised, classified, linked, validated, trust_scored, registered, searchable)
